name: kestrel-design-system
description: Kestrel — enterprise design system for the Kestrel ERP + CRM suite (HTML, SCSS, CSS variables, React + TypeScript).

scripts.build:css: sass styles/main.scss dist/kestrel.css --no-source-map && sass styles/main.scss dist/kestrel.min.css --style=compressed --no-source-map
